anomalies.observed: J8 pin 3, which the specification identifies as servo channel 2, connects through R17 to /NET0001. /NET0001 reaches only M5Stack bus pins 19 and 21 via R23/R12. J4 pin 3 connects through R11 to /NET0021, which reaches only bus pins 20 and 22 via R7/R18. The two PWM channel bus-pin groups are therefore reversed: J8 can select 19/21 rather than 20/22, and J4 can select 20/22 rather than 19/21.

anomalies.impact: In PWM mode, the pan and tilt servo channels are routed to the wrong M5Stack bus GPIO pairs. Firmware driving the intended PWM1/PWM2 pins will actuate the opposite servo header, swapping the pan and tilt channels; serial mode is less affected because R4/R8 merge the headers onto the MAX3485 bus.
